column1: # dialect_vocab.tsv — W88 (phase 3): lexicon-only dialect vocabulary, curated in-repo (no external corpus — no third-party license)
# format: word<TAB>h,n,g with 0/1 membership (h=hijazi n=najdi g=gulf). NOT detection markers: detection reads dialect_markers.tsv only.
# build_dialect.py appends these after the shared core; a word that is a marker or already present (normAr key) is skipped.
